---
title: "Extension"
description: "Extension and policy publications by Chandan Bhattarai"
---

My extension and policy work translates applied economic research into decision-relevant information for producers, agricultural lenders, policymakers, and other stakeholders. Much of this work focuses on the U.S. farm safety net, crop insurance, ARC-CO and PLC, and risk-management decisions.
